offers_products.reason: Main offering is communications service (broadband, mobile, voice); devices sold are incidental to connectivity service.

offers_services.reason: Operates telecom networks providing mobile, broadband and voice services in Caribbean, rural western US, Alaska, Navajo Nation.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential mobile and broadband subscribers in Bermuda, Cayman, Guyana, USVI and rural US are main buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Also sells enterprise, carrier and government connectivity, including wholesale and federal-funded rural network programs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription mobile, broadband and voice plans generate ongoing monthly service revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Essential connectivity subscriptions are rarely cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly fees for telecom service.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from owned networks and infrastructure, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households and small local businesses in rural and island markets.

asset_heavy.reason: Telecom operator needs continuous investment in fiber, wireless towers and network infrastructure.
